purpose: Independent analytic and behavioral acceptance fixtures,not execution of TFCalc or reproduction of its internals
phase_policy: fixed declared convention/reference plane; undefined amplitude-zero phase must be masked

tests.name: bare air/glass interface at normal incidence
tests.acceptance: absolute power error <=1e-12 for float64 analytic path; normal-incidence p amplitude may differ sign by declared phase convention

tests.name: ideal quarter-wave single-layer AR
tests.acceptance: R <=1e-12; |T−1| <=1e-12; finite d and units checked

tests.name: zero-thickness invariance
tests.acceptance: matches V01 within1e-12; removing layer must preserve neighboring interface response

tests.name: identical-material split invariance
tests.acceptance: absolute differences<=1e-12 away from singular or opaque t

tests.name: incoherent uncoated air/glass/air slab
tests.scope: nonabsorbing finite massive substrate, no front/back coatings
tests.acceptance: absolute power error<=1e-12; independent of substrate thickness when k=0; must not display coherent Fabry–Perot fringes

tests.name: matched substrate/exit no-backside mode
tests.acceptance: matches V01; distinguish this mode from transmission through slab

tests.name: Brewster angle
tests.acceptance: R_p<=1e-12; R_s>0; phase of p reflection undefined at amplitude zero

tests.name: total internal reflection
tests.acceptance: error<=1e-12; transmitted field can be nonzero evanescent while forward propagating power is0; phase continuous away from branch point

tests.name: quarter-wave Bragg mirror center
tests.scope: ten incident-to-exit H/L pairs, nonabsorbing normal incidence
tests.acceptance: absolute power error<=1e-11; test reversed LH order independently since center reflectance differs for substrate mismatch

tests.name: nondispersive matched delay
tests.scope: fixed input/output reference planes separated by finite slab; no interface contrast
tests.acceptance: GD relative error<=1e-8 in analytic path; derivative numerical tolerances obtained from convergence study; compare only same reference planes

tests.name: optical/physical thickness priority
tests.acceptance: exact rational behavior within roundoff; new reference changes phase only via changed d when optical priority

tests.name: group normalization invariance
tests.acceptance: same spectrum,objective and true thickness before/after normalization

tests.name: linear dielectric mixture
tests.acceptance: must not average n to1.5; rule name and passive root declared

tests.name: merit function powers and tolerances
tests.acceptance: within1e-12; preserve1/m factor inside1/k root; tolerance uniform scaling rescales F but not minimizers

tests.name: inequality feasibility
tests.acceptance: not claimed exact legacy boundary behavior; declare<= versus< boundary and apply consistently to yield

tests.name: interpolation and range handling
tests.scope: documented linear table plus configurable endpoint hold/warn
tests.acceptance: per-design policy preserved and warning cannot silently disappear

tests.name: phase convention invariance
tests.acceptance: no phase displayed at r≈0 without undefined-value indication

tests.name: observable-specific backside assumptions

input.vary: exit medium or backside coating only

tests.acceptance: test model selection rather than assuming one uniform substrate model for all observables

tests.name: zero-error sensitivity and yield
tests.acceptance: all quartiles/extrema identical; RNG seed does not affect zero-error results

tests.name: gradient consistency

input.cases: transparent AR,absorbing film,oblique mixed stack,group variable,shared-index material
input.check: analytic/autodiff gradient versus central difference for interior points; one-sided at d=0/bounds

expected.agreement: convergent difference as step reduces until roundoff; dimensionless directional derivative relative error<=1e-5 on well-conditioned cases

tests.acceptance: compare physical residual Jacobian as well as total objective; do not complex-step through absolute values or conjugations

tests.name: passivity energy and local field
tests.scope: nonabsorbing incidence, passive layers and exit
tests.acceptance: energy residual<=1e-10 for ordinary small stacks; stress tolerance is condition-number-aware; never enforce this blindly for absorptive incidence or gain

tests.name: sampling convergence

input.compare: gridΔ andΔ/2; independent denser holdout; peak/edge refinement

expected.holdout_specs: pass within physical tolerance,not only objective samples
expected.trend: errors decrease within algorithm convergence regime

tests.acceptance: set observable-specific thresholds in user units; narrowband unresolved peak is failure even when RMS is low
